service-call.name: mantle.sales.SalesReportServices.get#SalesOrderSummary
mantle.sales.SalesReportServices.get#SalesInvoiceSummary

actions.script:
defaultColors = ['rgba(92, 184, 92, 1.0)', 'rgba(91, 192, 222, 1.0)', 'rgba(240, 173, 78, 1.0)', 'rgba(217, 83, 79, 1.0)', 'rgba(60, 118, 61, 1.0)', 'rgba(49, 112, 143, 1.0)', 'rgba(138, 109, 59, 1.0)', 'rgba(169, 68, 66, 1.0)', 'rgba(223, 240, 216, 1.0)', 'rgba(217, 237, 247, 1.0)', 'rgba(252, 248, 227, 1.0)', 'rgba(242, 222, 222, 1.0)'] // half-up rounding to 2 places for amounts, and a ratio as a percent to 1 place const amount = (value) => Math.round((value || 0) * 100) / 100 const percent = (value) => Math.round((value || 0) * 1000) / 10 const column = (list, field, format) => list.map((line) => format ? format(line[field]) : line[field])
orderSummaryNoTotals = salesOrderSummaryList.slice(0, salesOrderSummaryList.length - 2) invoiceSummaryNoTotals = salesInvoiceSummaryList.slice(0, salesInvoiceSummaryList.length - 2) orderLabelList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'dateKey') invoiceLabelList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'dateKey')
newCustomerPercentList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'newCustomerPercent', percent) newCustomerPercentMaList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'newCustomerPercentMa', percent) orderProductSaleTotalList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'productSaleTotal', amount) orderNetSalesList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'netSales', amount) orderDiscountPercentList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'discountPercent', percent) orderDiscountPercentMaList = column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'discountPercentMa', percent)
invoiceTotalList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'invoiceTotal', amount) invoiceTotalMaList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'invoiceTotalMa', amount) invoicePaidPercentList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'paidPercent', percent) invoicePaidPercentMaList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'paidPercentMa', percent) invoicePrePaidPercentList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'prePaidPercent', percent) invoicePrePaidPercentMaList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'prePaidPercentMa', percent) invoiceCostPercentList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'costPercent', percent) invoiceCostPercentMaList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'costPercentMa', percent) invoiceDiscountPercentList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'discountPercent', percent) invoiceDiscountPercentMaList = column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'discountPercentMa', percent)
countSummaryDatasets = [ {label: 'Orders', backgroundColor: defaultColors[0], borderColor: defaultColors[0], fill: false, data: column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'orderCount')}, {label: 'New Customers', backgroundColor: defaultColors[1], borderColor: defaultColors[1], fill: false, data: column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'newCustomerOrderCount')}, {label: 'New Customer %', backgroundColor: defaultColors[3].replace('1.0', '0.5'), borderColor: defaultColors[3].replace('1.0', '0.5'), fill: false, yAxisID:'rightSide', data:newCustomerPercentList}, {label: 'Invoices', backgroundColor: defaultColors[2], borderColor: defaultColors[2], fill: false, data: column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'invoiceCount')}, ] orderAmountsDatasets = [ {label: 'Product Ordered', backgroundColor: defaultColors[0], borderColor: defaultColors[0], fill: false, data: orderProductSaleTotalList}, {label: 'Order Discounts', backgroundColor: defaultColors[1], borderColor: defaultColors[1], fill: false, data: column(orderSummaryNoTotals, 'discountTotal', (value) => -amount(value))}, {label: 'Discount %', backgroundColor: defaultColors[3].replace('1.0', '0.5'), borderColor: defaultColors[3].replace('1.0', '0.5'), fill: false, yAxisID: 'rightSide', data: orderDiscountPercentList }, ] invoiceMarginDatasets = [ {label: 'Product Invoiced', backgroundColor: defaultColors[0], borderColor: defaultColors[0], fill: false, type:'line', data: column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'productSaleTotal', amount)}, {label: 'Invoice Discounts', backgroundColor: defaultColors[1].replace('1.0', '0.4'), borderColor: defaultColors[1], stack:'DiscCost', data: column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'discountTotal', (value) => -amount(value))}, costShown ? {label: 'Product Cost', backgroundColor: defaultColors[4].replace('1.0', '0.4'), borderColor: defaultColors[4], stack:'DiscCost', data: column(invoiceSummaryNoTotals, 'productCostTotal', amount)} : null, ].filter(Boolean) discountCostDatasets = [ {label: 'Order Discount %', backgroundColor: defaultColors[0], borderColor: defaultColors[0], fill: false, data: orderDiscountPercentList}, {label: 'Invoice Discount %', backgroundColor: defaultColors[1], borderColor: defaultColors[1], fill: false, data: invoiceDiscountPercentList}, costShown ? {label: 'Invoice Cost %', backgroundColor: defaultColors[2], borderColor: defaultColors[2], fill: false, data: invoiceCostPercentList} : null, ].filter(Boolean)
// the summary charts, as Chart.js configs const lineConfig = (labels, datasets) => JSON.stringify({type:'line', data:{labels:labels, datasets:datasets}, options:{scales:{yAxes:[{position:'left', id:'leftSide', ticks:{beginAtZero:true}}, {position:'right', id:'rightSide', ticks:{beginAtZero:true}, gridLines:{drawOnChartArea:false}}]}, maintainAspectRatio:false}}) summaryCharts = [ {id:'CountSummaryChart', config:lineConfig(orderLabelList, countSummaryDatasets)}, {id:'OrderAmountChart', config:lineConfig(orderLabelList, orderAmountsDatasets)}, {id:'InvoiceMarginChart', config:JSON.stringify({type:'bar', data:{labels:invoiceLabelList, datasets:invoiceMarginDatasets}, options:{scales:{yAxes:[{ticks:{beginAtZero:true}}]}, maintainAspectRatio:false}})}, {id:'DiscountCostChart', config:JSON.stringify({type:'line', data:{labels:invoiceLabelList, datasets:discountCostDatasets}, options:{scales:{yAxes:[{ticks:{beginAtZero:true}}]}, maintainAspectRatio:false}})} ]
// the stats panels: this and last period, each against the one before and the average, and a trend chart const trendConfig = (labels, data, maData, big) => JSON.stringify({type:'line', data:{labels:labels, datasets: [{backgroundColor:'rgba(49, 112, 143, 0.9)', borderColor:'rgba(49, 112, 143, 0.9)', fill:false, data:data}].concat( maPeriods > 0 && maData && maData.length ? [{backgroundColor:null, borderColor:'rgba(240, 173, 78, 0.5)', fill:false, data:maData}] : [])}, options:{legend:{display:false}, scales:{xAxes:[{display:big}]}, maintainAspectRatio:false}}) const versus = (value, base, label, format) => ({down: value < base, label: label, base: ec.l10n.format(base, format), percent: base != 0 ? ec.l10n.format(Math.abs(value - base) / base * 100, '00') : '0'}) const statsPanel = (title, format, field, lines, list, labels, chartList, chartMaList) => { const [valThis, valLast, valPrior, valAvg] = lines.map((line) => (line && line[field]) || 0) chartList = chartList || column(list, field) chartMaList = chartMaList || column(list, field + 'Ma') return {title: title, id: title.replace(/[ -]/g, '_'), rows: [{label:'this', value:ec.l10n.format(valThis, format), versus:[versus(valThis, valLast, 'last', format), versus(valThis, valAvg, 'avg', format)]}, {label:'last', value:ec.l10n.format(valLast, format), versus:[versus(valLast, valPrior, 'prev', format), versus(valLast, valAvg, 'avg', format)]}], smallConfig: trendConfig(labels, chartList, chartMaList, false), bigConfig: trendConfig(labels, chartList, chartMaList, true)} } const orderLines = [ordersThis, ordersLast, ordersPrior, ordersAverage] const invoiceLines = [invoicesThis, invoicesLast, invoicesPrior, invoicesAverage] statsPanelRows = [[ statsPanel('Order Count', '#,##0', 'orderCount', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList), statsPanel('New Customer Count', '#,##0', 'newCustomerOrderCount', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList), statsPanel('New Customer Percent', '0.0%', 'newCustomerPercent', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList, newCustomerPercentList, newCustomerPercentMaList), statsPanel('Order Quantity', '#,##0', 'productQuantityTotal', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList), statsPanel('Order Product Sales', '$#,##0', 'productSaleTotal', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList, orderProductSaleTotalList), statsPanel('Order Discount Percent', '0.0%', 'discountPercent', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList, orderDiscountPercentList, orderDiscountPercentMaList), statsPanel('Order Net Product', '$#,##0', 'netSales', orderLines, orderSummaryNoTotals, orderLabelList, orderNetSalesList) ], [ statsPanel('Invoice Count', '#,##0', 'invoiceCount', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList), statsPanel('Invoiced Quantity', '#,##0', 'productQuantityTotal', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList), statsPanel('Invoices Total', '$#,##0', 'invoiceTotal', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList, invoiceTotalList, invoiceTotalMaList), statsPanel('Paid Percent', '0.0%', 'paidPercent', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList, invoicePaidPercentList, invoicePaidPercentMaList), statsPanel('Pre-Paid Percent', '0.0%', 'prePaidPercent', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList, invoicePrePaidPercentList, invoicePrePaidPercentMaList), costShown ? statsPanel('Invoice Cost Percent', '0.0%', 'costPercent', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList, invoiceCostPercentList, invoiceCostPercentMaList) : null, statsPanel('Invoice Discount Percent', '0.0%', 'discountPercent', invoiceLines, invoiceSummaryNoTotals, invoiceLabelList, invoiceDiscountPercentList, invoiceDiscountPercentMaList) ].filter(Boolean)]
